title: Noyonmoni
desc: Nayan's house catches fire after he is born, which makes people believe that he is a bad omen. His life changes drastically when his father is arrested.

title: Madhu Malati
desc: Malati, a rich landowner's daughter, and Debi, a simpleton, fall for Madhu, a popular man. However, he sees Debi as his friend and falls for Malati whose father has her betrothed to Rajesh, a thug.

title: Bidrohini Naari
desc: Saathi, a rebel, marries a rich man named Partho, but his family fails to welcome her. However, when her maid gets molested by her brother-in-law, she raises her voice against her in-laws.

title: Kamalar Banabas
desc: Banished from the kingdom under false pretences, Kamala endures hardship while raising her son, determined to clear her name and reunite with her loved ones.

title: Anutap
desc: A singer falls in love with a village beauty, and soon they get married. However, their marital bliss is dampened when they are separated due to an unfortunate event.
